subject.title: fix(gateway): require shared secret for tailscale serve auth

question: Should OpenClaw accept `gateway.auth.requireTailscaleSharedSecret` as the public layered Tailscale Serve auth contract once hot-session invalidation is fixed?
rationale: This PR adds a new Gateway authentication policy and changes how Tailscale identity composes with shared-secret auth, which is a security-boundary product decision rather than a routine code cleanup.

options.title: Accept after invalidation fix
options.body: Require the PR to include generation/config-write invalidation for this flag plus focused tests, then proceed with maintainer security review.

options.title: Defer to design issue
options.body: Keep the linked issue open for a broader layered-auth contract covering Tailscale, trusted-proxy, warnings, and Control UI pairing before accepting code.

options.title: Docs-only for now
options.body: Document the existing `allowTailscale: false` plus token/password hardening path and avoid adding a new auth config key in this PR.

recommendation.title: Accept after invalidation fix
recommendation.body: Require the PR to include generation/config-write invalidation for this flag plus focused tests, then proceed with maintainer security review.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent history across Tailscale auth, Gateway auth hardening, and related docs.
